evidence_summary: S36F increased reporter transactivation; the LOF and dominant-negative text describes other HNF1B alleles.
The source explicitly describes the RefSeq p.Arg451Cys allele with both gain- and loss-of-function effects.
Arg259His produces atrial gain of function but ventricular loss of function; it is not an exclusive GOF allele.
The heterozygous Gly343Arg allele belongs to the reported dominant GOF class; biallelic alleles in the same study explain the background LOF wording.
Phe302Leu has reported gain- and loss-of-function channel effects and cannot support an exclusive GOF call.
Asp567Tyr reduced SERCA2b pumping capacity; the GOF result in the paper belongs to a different tested allele.
Gly23Arg reduced SERCA2b pumping capacity; the GOF result in the paper belongs to a different tested allele.
Gly860Ser acquired a calcium-leak activity and is the GOF allele among the four ATP2A2 variants tested.
Ile1014Val reduced SERCA2b pumping capacity; the GOF result in the paper belongs to a different tested allele.
Phe508del causes defective CFTR folding, processing, trafficking, and channel availability; the cited review contrasts this LOF disorder with GOF folding disorders.
Gln886Ter is a truncating TET2 LOF allele; GOF in the article refers to the co-occurring KIT D816V allele.
